_note: User-editable settings for Aducks (or use the in-app Settings). Relaunch Aducks after editing by hand. (Graph endpoints and internal timings are built in - not configurable here on purpose.)
_browser_note: Which browser to launch for login. Must be Chromium-based (login capture uses the DevTools protocol). Use 'edge', 'chrome', or a full path to a Chromium browser exe.
_signin_note: CSS selector for the Graph Explorer button that opens the login prompt; it's clicked automatically once the page loads. Set to "" to disable auto-click. Only change this if Microsoft changes that button.
_capture_note: How many seconds to wait for you to finish signing in before giving up.
